verdict.rationale: HumanLayer is a platform that orchestrates and hosts coding-agent sessions such as Claude Code and Codex, not an agent itself, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint. The documented integrations (Jira, Slack, GitHub, Linear), the CLI and the automation runs are different capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
